rules.text: You may return any Fenty Beauty product within 30 days from the purchase date.
rules.quote: You may return any Fenty Beauty product within 30 days from the purchase date.

rules.text: Returns have free pre-paid shipping for all orders.
rules.quote: If you don't absolutely love your purchase, we offer free pre-paid returns for all for activ
rules.reviewNote: The quote is incomplete and does not fully confirm that all orders have free pre-paid shipping for returns. The summary overstates the information.

rules.text: Fenty Beauty does not offer exchanges, only returns.
rules.quote: At this time, we don’t offer exchanges—but we’d be happy to help with a return instead.

rules.text: TikTok Shop purchases are not eligible for exchanges.
rules.quote: At this time, TikTok Shop purchases are not eligible for exchanges.

rules.text: Refunds for TikTok Shop returns are typically processed within 3–5 business days after approval.
rules.quote: Refunds for TikTok Shop returns are typically processed within 3–5 business days after your return is approved.

rules.text: You must select all items you want refunded when starting a return; items not listed won’t be processed.
rules.quote: Please be sure to select all items you want refunded—any items not listed won’t be processed.

rules.text: Items with hazmat shipping restrictions like Fenty Eau de Parfum or Liquid Killawatt cannot be returned internationally.
rules.quote: We’re unable to accept returns on items with hazmat shipping restrictions (like Fenty Eau de Parfum or Liquid Killawatt).
rules.reviewNote: The quote does not specify that the hazmat return restriction applies only to international returns; the summary adds this limitation, which is not supported.

rules.text: Returns must be completed online if purchased from fentybeauty.com; no in-store returns for online orders.
rules.quote: If you purchased directly from www.fentybeauty.com, your return must be completed online.

rules.text: TikTok Shop returns must be processed through TikTok Shop.
rules.quote: All TikTok Shop orders must be returned directly through TikTok Shop.
